# `rotary_psd`

the two-sided Welch power spectral density of a recording's rotary pair through a stored rotation plane.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run rotary_psd --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run rotary_psd --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run rotary_psd --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --operator rest_plane_rotationPlane --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `plane` | operator rotation plane, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$operator"} | yes |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `operator` | `--operator` | `none` | - |  | the stored 2-row operator over the recording's channels (its rows a_x, a_y), by name |
| `name` | `--name` | `{recording}_{operator}_psd_welch` | - |  | the stored statistic's name; its segment partition is <name>_segments |
| `segment_seconds` | `--segment-seconds` | `4.0` | s |  | the segment's length in seconds (under segment_rule tile it snaps to the nearest 2^k samples) |
| `segment_samples` | `--segment-samples` | none | samples |  | the segment's length in samples (wins over segment_seconds; under tile a power of two); null: from segment_seconds |
| `segment_rule` | `--segment-rule` | `tile` | - | tile, round, even | how the segment's length becomes samples: tile = a tile of the recording's line (2^k samples, the span snaps to its grid) \| round = round(seconds x fs) from the span's start (Brainstorm, scipy) \| even = as round, made even (nxr's chain) |
| `overlap` | `--overlap` | `0.5` | fraction |  | the fraction of a segment shared with the next, in [0, 1): the hop is n - floor(n x overlap); under tile the hop must be a tile too (0, 0.5, 0.75, ...) |
| `window` | `--window` | `hamming` | - | hann, hamming, blackman, rectangular | the taper of each segment |
| `periodic` | `--periodic` | false | - |  | the DFT-even form of the window (scipy, nxr) rather than the symmetric one (MATLAB's hamming(n), Brainstorm) |
| `detrend` | `--detrend` | `constant` | - | none, constant, linear | what is removed from each segment before windowing |
| `scaling` | `--scaling` | `density` | - | density, spectrum, chain | density = power per Hz \| spectrum = power \| chain = per sample, per bin (nxr's spectral chain) |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - | exclude, ignore | exclude = a segment touching one of the recording's bad segments is left out \| ignore = every segment is kept |

## Presets

`--set <preset>` sets the parameters below at once; a parameter given by name wins over the preset.

| preset | sets |
|---|---|
| `tiles` | segment_rule=tile |
| `brainstorm` | segment_rule=round, window=hamming, periodic=false, detrend=constant, scaling=density |
| `scipy` | segment_rule=round, window=hann, periodic=true, detrend=constant, scaling=density |
| `nxr-chain` | segment_rule=even, window=hann, periodic=true, detrend=none, scaling=chain |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.linear_map`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, operator=plane |  | z |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.psd`](../nodes.md) | x=z, exclude=bad | segment_seconds=$segment_seconds, segment_samples=$segment_samples, segment_rule=$segment_rule, overlap=$overlap, window=$window, periodic=$periodic, detrend=$detrend, scaling=$scaling, bad_segments=$bad_segments | psd |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `psd` | kind statistic, name $name, of recording, axes [{"name": "pair"}, {"name": "frequency", "line": "{recording}_freq_signed"}], partition {"tiling": "$name_segments", "on": "recording.time"} |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE ROTARY SPECTRUM of a recording through a stored rotation plane (a statistic): z = a_x.X + i a_y.X (the plane's two rows applied to the channels), then the TWO-SIDED Welch PSD of z on a signed frequency
line, -fs/2 ... fs/2: the power of a pair turning from x towards y is at +f, the opposite sense at -f (the operator carries the sense; nothing is flipped here). The Welch parameters and presets are `psd`'s.
Stored: the statistic `<recording>_<operator>_psd_welch` (axes pair x frequency), its signed frequency line `<recording>_freq_signed` and its segment partition `<name>_segments`.

  nxr-neuro run rotary_psd --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --operator rest_plane_rotationPlane --all
```
